overview_description.description:
A Creator-Owned Multichain Protocol with Creators at Its Forefront and Its Core Powering A Create To Earn Revolution. The future of creation is distributed. We at Create are creators building web 3.0 technology and products for the creator community and helping them maximise revenue from the decentralised economy.
We are on a mission to integrate blockchain into the real lives of artists so that they get the value they deserve. CREATE is an ecosystem where creators are at the core that revolves around art, music & entertainment.
